Every keyboard shortcut entry the app lists.

## Actions

| Text | Catalog key |
| --- | --- |
| Undo the last action | `shortcut.undo_the_last_action` |
| Redo an undone action | `shortcut.redo_an_undone_action` |
| Save the design to its file | `shortcut.save_the_design_to_its` |
| Open the command palette | `shortcut.open_the_command_palette` |
| Move the highlight through the command list | `shortcut.move_the_highlight_through_the` |
| Load the highlighted command, then run it from the parameters box | `shortcut.load_the_highlighted_command_then` |
| Show or hide this shortcut list | `shortcut.show_or_hide_this_shortcut` |
| Copy the selected objects as text | `shortcut.copy_the_selected_objects_as` |
| Paste the copied objects, ready to move | `shortcut.paste_the_copied_objects_ready` |
| Select every object the pick chips allow | `shortcut.select_every_object_the_pick` |
| Add an object to the selection or take it out | `shortcut.add_an_object_to_the` |
| Draw a box and select what it touches | `shortcut.draw_a_box_and_select` |
| Measure tool: click two points to read the distance | `shortcut.measure_tool_click_two_points` |
| Open the symbol palette | `shortcut.open_the_symbol_palette` |
| Wire tool: click two pins to connect them | `shortcut.wire_tool_click_two_pins` |
| Route tool: click two pads to start a track | `shortcut.route_tool_click_two_pads` |
| Move tool: drop the selection at the cursor | `shortcut.move_tool_drop_the_selection` |
| Rotate the hovered or selected object by 90 degrees | `shortcut.rotate_the_hovered_or_selected` |
| Load the hovered or selected object into the inspector | `shortcut.load_the_hovered_or_selected` |
| Zoom the view so the whole design fits | `shortcut.zoom_the_view_so_the` |
| Delete every selected object | `shortcut.delete_every_selected_object` |
| Return to the select tool and close open palettes | `shortcut.return_to_the_select_tool` |
| Pan the view | `shortcut.pan_the_view` |
| Zoom the view | `shortcut.zoom_the_view` |
